#Let's share a moment

WELCOME TO DRUGSTORE

Because that's what life is about. Share moments with others. En de kunst bezitten om ze te koesteren en nóg meer waarde te geven. That's possible here. For almost 50 years. With a customized card for every time of the day. So that not a single moment is wasted. Welcome to Drugstore.

So yes, we have been involved for a while. For two family generations now. Recently with a completely new concept. Our two buildings underwent a total metamorphosis. Just like the Grote Markt, more than ever the beating heart of our beautiful city. And our faithful companion all these years. Drugstore is anchored to this place. Where everything revolves around meeting. Ons zomer- én winterterras zijn rustpunten voor de bezoeker en een beetje thuiskomen voor elke Hasselaar.

Explore our business. Breathe in the atmosphere and the smell of our Mibrasa and pizza oven. The best of both worlds. North and south. They reveal what the new Drugstore stands for: natural aromas, unique flavors, food sharing and a varied and creative offering. Without losing sight of the classics. Bezoek onze stijlvolle wijnfrigo en maak zelf je selectie voor je lunch of diner. Or for an aperitif by the atmospheric fireplace.

Every corner of our business tells a story

story. Like the neon lighting

verwijst naar de iconische voorgevel van weleer en de langgerekte bar die de twee voormalige gebouwen naadloos met elkaar verbindt. Like one big family. This is where your moments will be at their best.

# White wine tips from Maarten Hofenk

# California Roots 'Chardonnay' Fresh, fruity

The best ingredients for a good life are simple: good food, good friends and especially good wine! This Chardonnay from California has a light yellow, clear color. In the nose we mainly find aromas of white pome fruit (peach, nectarine, etc.) and blossoms. The taste is smooth, smooth and elegant. In short, a price-friendly Chardonnay with great charm!

# Le Pas du Moine Château Gassier 'Rolle /Ugni Blanc'

# Terroir, amicable

Top white wine from the Gassier house, now for 5 generations. Château Gassier is located in the heart of the Arc Valley east of Aix-en-Provence. A very tasty, fresh white wine from the Côtes de Provence! Delicious nose of lychee and mango with a subtle touch of flowers and exotic fruit. A nice combination of length, complexity and long finish. A major surprise!

# Winkl Cantina Terlan 'Sauvignon Blanc'

Terroir, amicable

Cantina Terlano, founded in 1893, has a long tradition of producing white wines. The high altitude Winkl sub-region is the supplier of superior Sauvignon grapes. You can safely place this Cuvée of $100%$ Sauvignon Blanc next to the very best Sancerre and Pouilly Fumé wines.Sen. Delicious Sauvignon blanc with typical aromas of white fruit and passion fruit. A little bit of lychee and citrus. Highly recommended for real Sauvignon Blanc lovers!

# La Rocca Pieropan 'Garganega'

# Full-Bodied
